title: Soviet psychokinesis experiments on mice in submarines

tellings.quote: But obviously I mean as the Soviets figured out in the 1970s when they were taking mice down in submarines and trying to stop their hearts, you can use the same thing to kill somebody.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that in the 1970s Soviet researchers took mice down in submarines and tried to stop their hearts using psychokinesis, the supposed power of the mind to affect physical things. Jorjani says the Soviets figured out this power could be used to kill a person, which, if true, would make the mind a possible weapon.
